lessons_used: Predictions were usually too high compared to noise-corrected measurements in four of the five rounds, though round 5 was slightly under-predicted.
Evidence is still thin for adoption redesigns, as only one test has been completed and no clear effect was seen.
Evidence is still thin for sign-in copy changes, as only one test has been completed and no clear effect was seen.
Sign-in reordering changes average +2.7% after noise correction across three tests, with two tests proving helpful (won) and one showing no clear effect.

candidates.title: Story Scroll Path Experience
candidates.change: Redesign the path selection screen into a story scroll layout that showcases default versus custom pet generation with rich visual previews.
candidates.why: Path selection drops 23.8% of users with an 8s median time; introducing visual narrative cards helps users make a confident path choice.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Companion Path
choose_path.body: Scroll down to select between pre-crafted friends or custom AI creation.

guard.reason: Valid redesign of choose_path that retains both adoption and custom creation options.

candidates.score_note: Target step loses 23.8%, but UI redesigns have weak confidence and require new screens.

candidates.title: Pre-Adoption Sign-In Shift
candidates.change: Move sign-in to take place immediately after path selection and before pet customization.
candidates.why: Sign-in reordering changes yield average +2.7% performance across previous tests, and placing sign-in earlier secures user state prior to rendering assets.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in step within onboarding is explicitly allowed.

candidates.score_note: Sign-in reordering is a proven pattern averaging +2.7% across past tests.

candidates.title: Pet Trait Customization Screen
candidates.change: Insert a dedicated companion trait selection screen right before photo upload to define personality and visual style early.
candidates.why: Adoption is the largest drop-off point during pet creation (60.9% conversion) and support receives complaints about custom pets looking or behaving wrong.

new_trait_selection.headline: Define Companion Trait Style
new_trait_selection.body: Select temperament and visual theme preferences for your new desktop pet.

guard.reason: Adding a new customization screen within onboarding is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Largest drop-off step with direct support mail, but new screens carry low confidence and high cost.

candidates.title: Generation Progress Details
candidates.change: Display active progress updates and live time estimate indicators on the waiting screen during pet rendering.
candidates.why: The waiting screen takes a long median time (201s) and high mean (2336s), causing uncertainty about whether pet creation is stalling.

waiting.headline: Rendering Your Desktop Pet
waiting.body: We are preparing graphics and animations for your desktop companion.

guard.reason: Adding progress and live time indicators to the waiting screen is permitted for real waits.

candidates.score_note: Addresses high median (201s) and mean (2336s) wait time on home step.

candidates.title: Desktop Display Diagnostic Flow
candidates.change: Add an integrated screen check flow on the final onboarding step to verify overlay permissions and multi-monitor visibility.
candidates.why: Finish stage converts at only 64.8% and support received multiple emails reporting that pets do not show on the desktop or the app fails to open.

home_intro.headline: Verify Desktop Overlay Settings
home_intro.body: Ensure your desktop pet permissions are enabled so your companion appears seamlessly over windows.

guard.reason: Adding diagnostic sub-flow steps to home_intro inside onboarding is allowed.

candidates.score_note: High drop-off (35.2%) backed by support tickets, though requires a new diagnostic flow.

candidates.title: Split View Companion Selector
candidates.change: Switch the pet selection screen to a split-screen view featuring interactive previews alongside companion summary details.
candidates.why: Adoption has a heavy drop-off (60.9% conversion) and a high mean time (1017s); a side-by-side comparison speeds up decision making.

pick_friend.headline: Select Your Ideal Companion
pick_friend.body: Compare companion traits and visuals side-by-side.

guard.reason: Redesigning pick_friend with a split view preserves its core function.

candidates.score_note: Target step drops 39.1%, but adoption redesigns yielded only +0.2% previously.

candidates.title: Account Sync Guarantee Note
candidates.change: Add explicit reassurance copy on the sign-in screen explaining that account creation permanently protects adopt status and companion data.
candidates.why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or resetting after signing back in.

sign_in.headline: Secure Your Companion Account
sign_in.body: Signing in binds your chosen pet and progress to your account so you never lose your companion.
sign_in.hint: Your pet progress syncs automatically across logins.

guard.reason: Updating sign-in copy to explain sync functionality is allowed inside onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Strong evidence from 8 emails and config-only cost, but sign-in copy tests showed negative lift (-0.6%).

candidates.title: Ready Desktop Alert System
candidates.change: Enable optional background notifications while pet assets render so users can safely minimize the app.
candidates.why: Waiting stage mean time is 2336s (nearly 39 minutes); users benefit from knowing when it is safe to background the app.

waiting.hint: We'll notify you as soon as your pet is ready on your desktop!

guard.reason: Adding background ready notifications to the waiting screen is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Helps users handle the 2336s mean waiting time by enabling background alerts.

candidates.title: Onboarding Time Expectation Hint
candidates.change: Add an estimated setup duration hint to the path selection screen so users know setup involves a quick generation process.
candidates.why: Mean finish time is 5815s overall due to deep asset creation; setting clear expectations upfront reduces early abandonment.

choose_path.hint: Path setup takes under 2 minutes before background rendering begins.

guard.reason: Adding setup time estimation hints on path selection is permitted.

candidates.score_note: Config-only hint setting expectations for path selection step.

candidates.title: Companion Control Primer Copy
candidates.change: Update final screen body text with direct instructions on how to interact with, hide, or trigger desktop actions for the pet.
candidates.why: Support logged 3 separate tickets from users confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after finishing onboarding.

home_intro.headline: Your Companion is Ready!
home_intro.body: Right-click your pet on the desktop anytime to open controls, toggle visibility, or start a conversation.
home_intro.hint: Use right-click or system tray icon for quick controls.

guard.reason: Updating home_intro instructional copy is allowed.

candidates.score_note: Low cost copy tweak addressing 3 support tickets on finish step interaction.
